strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Email Hiding Rules

analytics.name: Analytic 0551
analytics.guidance: Suspicious creation or modification of inbox rules through PowerShell (New-InboxRule, Set-InboxRule) to automatically delete, move, or hide emails. Defender perspective: unusual rule activity correlated with mailbox access and filtering patterns.

tuning.description: Keywords like 'phish', 'malware', 'suspicious' used in inbox rules to hide emails.
Scope mailbox monitoring to high-value users such as executives or admins.

log_sources.name: m365:unified
log_sources.channel: New-InboxRule or Set-InboxRule events recorded in Exchange Online

analytics.name: Analytic 0552
analytics.guidance: Alterations to plist configuration files (RulesActiveState.plist, SyncedRules.plist, UnsyncedRules.plist, MessageRules.plist) that define email hiding or filtering rules. Defender perspective: unexpected changes in these files associated with Mail.app processes.

tuning.description: Adjust to monitor only rule-related plist files relevant to the environment.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Modifications to Mail.app plist files controlling message rules

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Mail.app executing with parameters updating rules state

analytics.name: Analytic 0553
analytics.guidance: Rule manipulation through local email clients (e.g., Evolution, Thunderbird) or server-side filtering scripts (e.g., sieve) creating conditions to move or discard emails with security-related keywords.

tuning.description: Customize based on mail server software (Postfix, Dovecot, Exim).

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve calls modifying local mail filter configuration files

log_sources.name: ApplicationLog:MailServer
log_sources.channel: Unexpected additions of sieve rules or filtering directives

analytics.name: Analytic 0554
analytics.guidance: Suspicious rule creation within Outlook or Exchange clients, including auto-move or delete conditions tied to incident or security alert keywords. Defender perspective: correlation between missing inbound emails and newly added mailbox rules.

tuning.description: Decide whether to monitor individual mailbox rules, org-wide transport rules, or both.

log_sources.name: m365:unified
log_sources.channel: Transport rule or inbox rule creation events
